text: Let go of the idea of a “second half.” Accept that you are not a half—you are initially whole! And a beloved person is not someone who must complete you, but someone with whom you unite in your fullness. The mind does not understand, but the heart feels that this is so—that two whole infinite universes dancing together create something far more beautiful than two incomplete little people clinging to each other, feeling at the same time the desire to become more whole and the fear of losing each other as a result of their development.
